plain: One who dies for the truth of their faith, or suffers for a cause.

webster.text: One who, by his death, bears witness to the truth of the gospel.

example.quote: And it required the spirit of a martyr, for the judges to determine contrary to the king's will. — They were absolutely dependent upon him both for their offices and livings.
example.cite: Brutus XV, New York Journal, Mar. 20, 1788
